## Clicker 1 (sign)

If $\Delta\lambda = \lambda_{\text{obs}} - \lambda_0$ is negative, the source is:

A) Receding  
B) Approaching  
C) Not moving  

**Answer:** B

## Clicker 2 (radial vs transverse)

A star is moving at 200 km/s exactly sideways across the sky. Its Doppler shift is:

A) Large redshift  
B) Large blueshift  
C) Zero  

**Answer:** C

## Short answer (fraction shift)

Explain why a Doppler shift is often described as a “fractional shift” instead of a fixed number of nanometers.
